domain.Answered.description: The answer to the field at path: its values, as many as the field takes, an array even when it takes none.

domain.Envelope.description: How a command's run ended: its operation, its items once applied, the plan and its fingerprint on a dry run, the commands to run next, its warnings and its failure.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of a dry run's plan, which its apply is held to.

items.description: The outcome of each subject, once applied or read.

ok.description: Whether the command succeeded: false exactly when error is present.

op.description: The operation's id; absent for a read, and for a request refused before its operation began.

plan.description: The plan, on a dry run and once applied; absent for a read and a refusal. Each command's envelope says its shape.

domain.Error.description: A failure: its kind, what the caller can do about it, its stable code, its message, and the problems of each field of an invalid request.

domain.Field.description: One field of a form, of the kind its kind names.

domain.FieldError.description: One problem with one field of a request, named by its path, and by its flag on the command line.

accepted.description: The values the field accepts, when they are a closed set.

flag.description: How the surface spells the field: its flag on the command line, its path elsewhere.

path.description: The field, as the request names it: from, remember[0].

with.description: The other fields the problem involves.

domain.Form.description: A command's request as a schema a surface renders without knowing the command: its fields in the order a wizard asks them, the sections a surface groups them in, and the request's problems.

sections.description: In the order a surface shows them; a field names its own by key.

domain.Item.description: The outcome of one subject of an operation or a read: a worktree for instance.

detail.description: What the command reports of the subject, {} when nothing. Each command's envelope says its shape.

reason.description: What qualifies the status; absent when nothing does.

description: What the catalogue of wtm's commands sends a surface other than the command line: the v2 envelope, the form of a request and its fields, the events of an operation, and each command's request, plan, detail and envelope under $defs.
